session.title: Aside CLI release and research feature audit

messages.text:
# Aside CLI audit addendum

**As of:** 2026-10-09, Asia/Seoul. No discovery was repeated, other sessions inspected, settings changed, or user defaults overridden.

- **Official latest CLI, previously verified:** <citation refs="xLtvs0FHQnkThr-gR33nt">**1.26.1008.1938**, from the original [CLI release manifest](https://releases.aside.com/cli/AsideCLI-darwin-arm64-latest.json): `"version":"1.26.1008.1938"`, `"platform":"darwin-arm64"`.</citation> This is CLI metadata, not a desktop-app version.

- **Appropriate features:** Use `exec` for delegated discovery; `repl` for original-page inspection, snapshots, screenshots, and deterministic auditing; installed `guide`/`guide repl` and `skills list`/`skills show` for detailed instructions. <citation refs="1N6kbg068aoi0xfaZODXl">[Public developer help](https://docs.aside.com/help/developers) documents browser-agent tasks and REPL auditing.</citation> <citation refs="EslPIcKw-tjJNK7EvDkxt">The [Components changelog](https://docs.aside.com/changelog/components.md) documents `session resume` under `v1.26.902.1713`, September 2, 2026.</citation>

- **Installed-help priority:** Public help shows `aside --session <id> "Continue"`. Installed **1.26.916.1741** help instead documents `aside session resume <id> [prompt]`, without resume-specific model/effort flags. Follow installed help over stale public syntax. Installed `exec` supports optional `--effort ultrabrowse`; omit unrequested overrides to preserve user defaults.

- **Retrieval correction, installed/runtime evidence:** The installed built-in `aside` skill documents read-only:
  ```js
  aside.sessions.get(id)
  await aside.sessions.messages(id, {limit:4, order:"desc"})
  ```
  The caller reports executing these **only for this investigation**, recovering status **`idle`** and the **complete final assistant answer**. Therefore, observed REPL retrieval exists. The earlier gap concerns a dedicated CLI retrieval command and release-pinned public API documentation, not all retrieval methods. Four messages do not generally guarantee a complete transcript.

- **Remaining limits:** Installed/runtime evidence concerns **1.26.916.1741**, not **1.26.1008.1938**. Latest-release compatibility of detailed REPL APIs, site-skill globals, flags, resume syntax, and retrieval schemas remains unverified. Public help is unversioned; <citation refs="EslPIcKw-tjJNK7EvDkxt">the inspected Components changelog’s newest entry is `v1.26.1007.1853`, October 7, 2026.</citation> No update or installation is required for this read-only audit.

# Official Aside CLI audit

**As of:** 2026-10-09, Asia/Seoul.  
**Publisher:** Aside / At Your Side Inc. Public help pages are undated and unversioned unless noted.

No private sessions, accounts, or personal memory were inspected. No software updates, installations, or settings changes were performed.

## Claim ledger

### C1. Latest publicly advertised CLI: **1.26.1008.1938**

<citation refs="xLtvs0FHQnkThr-gR33nt,Hg76J8tm1J-U9YU32i5nX,54I0njjMhUVtC56JnMlh5,OSJMUpZ6HFY7E99dcmPdc,iVWh5wE4OKNpnyBZ7JKQ2">All five official platform-specific latest manifests report `1.26.1008.1938`.</citation>

Exact original metadata URLs, JSON resources without page titles:

- https://releases.aside.com/cli/AsideCLI-darwin-arm64-latest.json
- https://releases.aside.com/cli/AsideCLI-darwin-x64-latest.json
- https://releases.aside.com/cli/AsideCLI-win-x64-latest.json
- https://releases.aside.com/cli/AsideCLI-linux-x64-latest.json
- https://releases.aside.com/cli/AsideCLI-linux-arm64-latest.json

Supporting datum: `"version":"1.26.1008.1938"`.

The ARM64 manifest’s HTTP `Last-Modified` was **2026-10-08 19:41:22 Asia/Seoul**. This is an object-modification timestamp, **not a declared publication date**. Versioned macOS ARM64 and Windows archives returned HTTP 200 to HEAD requests; binaries were not downloaded or executed.

### C2. CLI and desktop versions are separate

<citation refs="Wos8essLVhTxz8xR07Pfj">The official [`install.ps1`](https://releases.aside.com/install.ps1) explicitly pins `$ReleaseVersion = '1.26.1008.1938'` and names `AsideCLI` archives.</citation>

<citation refs="VoGjVYp8FonkxecnSgnYy,EslPIcKw-tjJNK7EvDkxt">By contrast, **[Aside Browser](https://docs.aside.com/changelog/native)** starts its native-app changelog at `v1.0.928.1`; **[Components](https://docs.aside.com/changelog/components.md)** starts at `v1.26.1007.1853`, dated October 7, 2026.</citation> Neither heading establishes the latest CLI version.

### C3. Discovery: `exec` is documented; latest flags are not established

<citation refs="1N6kbg068aoi0xfaZODXl">**[Use the CLI, MCP, and REPL](https://docs.aside.com/help/developers)** documents starting browser-agent tasks with `aside "<prompt>"` and includes an `aside exec` example.</citation>

<citation refs="fZ7jqSykhhhJrfuj_ulXF">**[Use Ultrabrowse](https://docs.aside.com/help/ultrabrowse.md)** recommends it for “source-heavy research” and “research that needs citations,” but supplies no CLI flag syntax.</citation>

**Installed-version evidence only:** `1.26.916.1741` help supports `--effort ultrabrowse`, model/provider/speed selection, and host/account targeting. These flags were **not verified against `1.26.1008.1938`**.

### C4. Original-source auditing: REPL is publicly documented

<citation refs="1N6kbg068aoi0xfaZODXl">Developer help recommends REPL for “direct page inspection, screenshots, downloads, or deterministic browser steps.”</citation>

<citation refs="YMUxV6N2fJdHZtcvgnuay,oHMdas8z91rs9t3eeabiE">**[Aside for Developers](https://aside.com/blog/developers)**, June 22, 2026, additionally describes pages, tabs, locators, snapshots, and element refs.</citation>

**Installed guide only:** `aside guide repl` documents `snapshot()` returning `tree`/`diff`, screenshots, tab attachment, persistent JavaScript bindings, `console.log()`, and a 120-second timeout. Snapshot refs must be refreshed after actions. This detailed API contract is not publicly pinned to the latest release.

### C5. Guides and site skills: partly publicly documented

**Installed evidence:** `aside guide`, `aside guide repl`, `aside skills list [--json]`, and `aside skills show <name>` provide instructions and site-skill discovery.

<citation refs="EslPIcKw-tjJNK7EvDkxt">**Components** records `skills list/show` under `v1.26.902.847` and `skills install` under `v1.26.902.1713`, both September 2, 2026. Excerpt: “`aside skills install` installs the aside-browser skill into Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or OpenCode.”</citation>

Installation is a write operation. Detailed site-global/API contracts remain installed-guide evidence rather than release-pinned public documentation.

### C6. Resumption: documented, but syntax differs

<citation refs="EslPIcKw-tjJNK7EvDkxt">**Components**, `v1.26.902.1713`, says: “Resume a chat with `aside session resume`.”</citation>

Installed help accepts `aside session resume <id> [prompt]`; its command-specific options include account selection, **not model or effort**.

<citation refs="1N6kbg068aoi0xfaZODXl">Public developer help instead shows `aside --session <session-id> "Continue"`.</citation> That flag is absent from installed root help. Latest-release support and equivalence are unresolved.

Installed guides also describe `steer`, `queue`, and `stop`. These control execution and are not read-only retrieval methods.

### C7. Read-only checks versus updating

- `aside --version`: verified locally, returning **`1.26.916.1741`**.
- GET a latest manifest: checks the advertised release without invoking installation.
- Help and guide commands: inspect the installed command contract.

**Do not use `aside update` or `--update` as check-only.** Installed help says “Check for updates and install the newest release”; <citation refs="EslPIcKw-tjJNK7EvDkxt">Components explicitly says “`aside update` upgrades the CLI.”</citation> No check-only/dry-run flag appears in installed update help.

### C8. Session status/result retrieval: limited or unresolved

Installed `aside session list` documents listing sessions, including unsaved sessions, but specifies no JSON/status/result options. It was **not executed**. Installed session help exposes no dedicated status/result/transcript retrieval command.

<citation refs="1N6kbg068aoi0xfaZODXl,W6Pl1kswIZgV-gbFEx14b">Developer help and **[Run tasks](https://docs.aside.com/help/tasks.md)** provide no machine-readable retrieval schema; task help describes waits, resumption, and transcript storage instead.</citation> This bounded finding does not prove undocumented APIs are absent.

## Recommendation and gaps

Use **`exec` for discovery**, **REPL for inspectable source evidence**, and **`session resume` for continuation**, after checking the target installation’s help. Require exact URLs, observation dates, excerpts, and evidence independent of agent summaries.

Unresolved: CLI-specific release notes, publication date, release-pinned guides/APIs, latest flag compatibility, and machine-readable status/results. Installed REPL help also mentions `getTabs()`, while its detailed guide documents `listBrowserTabs()`.

Prompt explicitly for read-only work. **Guard is not a documented browser-wide read-only guarantee.**
